description: A reusable map from terrain surface roles to material assets, used when generated terrain assigns surfaces from slope, deposition, biome and water distance. Roles are keyed by name, so a duplicate role is structurally impossible and iteration order is deterministic. The role vocabulary, the material-asset type rule, required_roles coverage and every range rule are enforced by src/demi/assets/MaterialSet.cpp, because this validator ignores additionalProperties, minItems, maxItems, maxLength, pattern and uniqueItems.

cliff.description: Near-vertical faces, which need a triplanar material.

required_roles.description: Roles a consumer must find to treat the set as usable.
